title: 🎮 I just found a crazy open-source project: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
author: Ill_Information_3661
selftext:
​

⭐️ 11,574 GitHub stars

📈 +1,107 stars today

So what is it?

An entire AI-agent-powered game development studio.

Sounds futuristic, right?

But the real impact is much bigger.

🎯 The old way:

A game usually needs:

👨‍💻 Developers

🎨 Artists

📝 Game designers

🧪 QA testers

⚙️ Technical artists

Even a small team can easily require 5–10 people.

Now this project uses 49 AI Agents, each handling a different part of the workflow.

Some write code.

Some create assets.

Some test for bugs.

Others optimize performance.

🧠 72 workflow skills cover the development pipeline from start to finish.

And here's the crazy part:

These agents are powered by Claude Code and can:

🤖 Make decisions

🔄 Self-correct

🤝 Collaborate with each other

🎮 Build playable games

I checked out some of their demo games.

They're still relatively simple, but the level of completeness is surprisingly impressive.

From:

💡 Concept

→ 💻 Development

→ 🎨 Assets

→ 🧪 Testing

→ 🎮 Playable build

All handled by AI agents.

The future of game development might not be a 10-person studio.

It might be one person + 49 AI agents.

🔥 Can AI actually build a hit game?

We'll see.

🔗 GitHub:

https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
